definitions.name: IMU pod (sample)
definitions.description: The UHD fixture IMU board in a two-part printed enclosure. Viewer fixture for boards and enclosures (PB-823).

definitions.name: IMU board (fixture + sample outputs)
definitions.description: Synthetic MCU + IMU on I2C 0, 3.3 V from a synthetic buck-boost regulator. Test fixture for the board convention; not a complete design. Viewer sample: the UHD fixture board with mounting holes and hand-made standard outputs.

params.reason: Fixture requirement: fits a 30 × 20 mm bay.
Component positions, mounting holes and edge pads are chosen by hand for the viewer's fixtures; nothing was laid out or routed.

definitions.name: IMU pod enclosure (sample)
definitions.description: Two-part printed enclosure: a back shell with two bosses for the board, and a lid with a window over the SWD pads. Sample definition with hand-made cad outputs.

params.note: M2 self-tapping screws into printed bosses (sample assumption)

params.text: Opening for the battery lead to the VIN and GND pads.
Window in the lid over the SWD pads, for a pogo-pin adapter.

material.name: PLA
material.assumption: Typical PLA density, assumed for the sample enclosure; no source states it.

definitions.name: Fixture microcontroller (synthetic)
definitions.description: Invented microcontroller for tests: 24 I/O pins, one I2C controller on PA0/PA1, SWD, VDDIO 1.62-3.6 V, an internal 1.2 V core regulator (VREG_IN to VREG_OUT) that feeds its VCORE pins, 32-pin QFN with exposed pad. Not a real part.

params.description: Factory test mode; tie to GND

definitions.name: Fixture 6-axis IMU (synthetic)
definitions.description: Invented 6-axis IMU for tests: I2C target at 0x6A/0x6B (ADDR strap) or SPI target on the same pads, VDD 1.71-3.6 V, VDDIO 1.2-3.6 V, 12-pad LGA. Not a real part.

params.description: SPI chip select; tie high for I2C

interfaceGroups.label: Host interface (I2C or SPI, shared pads)

definitions.name: Fixture buck-boost regulator (synthetic)
definitions.description: Invented adjustable buck-boost regulator for tests: VIN 2.0-5.5 V, VOUT 1.0-5.5 V set by a divider to a 0.6 V reference, 1.5 A output, 12-pin SON with exposed pad. Not a real part.

params.description: High: forced PWM; low: power save

interfaceGroups.label: VIN pins 1 and 2 (both must be connected)
VOUT pins 8 and 9 (both must be connected)

params.assumption: Inductor value chosen for the fixture regulator.

package.assumption: Chip size chosen for the fixture.

params.assumption: Feedback divider for 3.3 V on the fixture regulator's 0.6 V reference. Upper resistor.

package.assumption: Chip size chosen for the fixture.

params.assumption: Feedback divider for 3.3 V on the fixture regulator's 0.6 V reference. Lower resistor.

package.assumption: Chip size chosen for the fixture.

params.assumption: I2C pull-up value: a common choice at 400 kHz and 3.3 V, not sized from bus capacitance.

scenarios.label: IMU SDx and INT1 swapped
scenarios.description: The IMU's SDx (u2 pin 1) is on the IMU_INT1 net and its INT1 (pin 5) on SDA: the I2C bus between the MCU and the IMU is incomplete.
